page.overview:
Who is Dr. Dextrose?

Dr. Dextrose resembles a marshmallow wearing a suit and has rouge hair. Like most doctors in Ooo, he has a Scientific Parasite living in his coat pocket, which is a little creature that feeds on "smart brain waves."
